# NexusFlow Copilot Instructions

Before analyzing or changing this repository, read `/WIKI.md` in full, then follow `/AGENTS.md`.

Treat current code, SQL migrations, and verified production state as higher priority than historical review documents or chat summaries. Preserve the billing, account ownership, authorization, model-ID encoding, logging, and deployment invariants documented there.

Never commit secrets, `.env` contents, customer data, or request/response bodies. Update `/WIKI.md` whenever a change alters project architecture, protocol behavior, billing, security, operations, or deployment facts.
